This is something from my todo list :)

Actually, photos are not the most problematic type of files here, classical office files contain way too much information which is not intended to be shared.

At the same time, some sites have intention to share metadata from files (like photo sharing sites, where exif information is meant to be shared), so requirement need to take this in account.

Agree with category proposal 8.3.

Alternatives:
  * [V14.3](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/4.0/en/0x22-V14-Config.md#v143-unintended-security-disclosure-requirements) Unintended Security Disclosure Requirements
  * V12.* Somewhere in fileupload/servince related categories - but as metadata information should be stripped out also from files which are generated by the application, then it's not maybe the best category

Current 12.3.3 covers it a bit, but with a perspective to ignore metadata and it is important only for avoiding RCE, RFI and SSRF attacks. But ignoring does not mean removing it from files...
> **Verify that user-submitted filename metadata is validated or ignored** to prevent the disclosure or execution of remote files via Remote File Inclusion (RFI) or Server-side Request Forgery (SSRF) attacks.

> For security investigations for example. Like you should not delete file when virus is detected from uploaded file, you should store it for investigations.
> 
> One option is to ask from user.

What you are suggesting is sometimes a violation of GDPR and other privacy regulations. You may only store and process data per user consent.

> For security investigations for example. Like you should not delete file when virus is detected from uploaded file, you should store it for investigations.
> 
> One option is to ask from user.

What you are suggesting is often a violation of GDPR and other privacy regulations. You may only store and process data per use consent.

> Any proposals for CWE and ASVS Levels as well?

CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor. 

or 

CWE-212: Improper Removal of Sensitive Information Before Storage or Transfer

This is often verifiable externally and is likely applicable to nearly every company so I would put it in level 1.

> Any proposals for CWE and ASVS Levels as well?

Maybe CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor.
